Safety review of policy.pt (done BEFORE any torch.jit.load):
- Opened as a ZIP; read every code/__torch__/*.py (TorchScript source) and disassembled data.pkl
  with pickletools (no unpickling).
- Content: isaaclab_rl.rsl_rl.exporter._TorchPolicyExporter = Identity normalizer +
  Sequential(Linear 45->512, ELU, Linear 512->256, ELU, Linear 256->128, ELU, Linear 128->12).
  Ops used: torch.linear, torch.elu. No file/network/os/subprocess/eval calls.
- data.pkl globals: only torch module classes, collections.OrderedDict, torch.FloatStorage,
  torch._utils._rebuild_tensor_v2. debug_pkl files: only torch.jit._pickle.build_intlist.
- The runner re-checks the sha256 above before every load (robot_lab_go2.MODEL_SHA256).
